parts.label: Absolute pressure in either initial bubble
parts.help: Absolute pressure, not pressure excess. Use pₐ = 101000 Pa. Tolerance ±0.02 Pa.

parts.label: Outer radius of either attached bubble
parts.help: Ideal gas, separately conserved amounts, isothermal process. Use absolute pressures. Enter the radius in cm.

parts.label: Radius of curvature of the common interface
parts.help: Equal pressures give a flat film. Use \infty for an unbounded radius, not zero radius.

parts.label: Centre separation in terms of the common final radius
parts.help: Use R_p for the common outer radius R′ after attachment. Each centre is R′/2 from the shared plane.

parts.label: Separating-film radius
parts.help: Enter the result in the displayed unit, without a unit suffix.

parts.label: Centre separation
parts.help: Enter the result in the displayed unit, without a unit suffix.
